about: Round 1583. The record the NBA Connections checker judges every tile by: ESPN's public athlete service (site.web.api.espn.com, the athlete and its stats: clubs season by season from the regular season rows, career regular season totals, the birthplace as ESPN prints it and its country, ESPN's active flag and draft line) and nba.com's player page (the person id from the league's player index, the roster status and the draft with its overall pick). The second host for every fact is basketball-reference.com (scripts/data/nbaConnectionsSecondHost-2026-10.json), and the checker reads both: where the two disagree on a verdict it returns unknown, never a guess. ESPN keeps no seasons for Larry Bird and an incomplete record for some other early careers (no Milwaukee seasons and offensive plus defensive rebounds only for Kareem Abdul-Jabbar; rebounds were not split before 1973-74): those are decided in scripts/data/nbaConnectionsVerified-2026-10.json (overlay) on two hosts. ESPN names a moved or renamed club's old seasons by the club as it then was (Seattle SuperSonics, New Jersey Nets, New Orleans Hornets, NO/Oklahoma City Hornets, Charlotte Bobcats, San Diego Rockets, Buffalo Braves) and the Clippers under two names (LA Clippers, Los Angeles Clippers). Totals move while a season is played: the read date holds them. Regenerate with scripts/usConnections/fetchNbaRecord.mjs; never edit by hand.
